name: A Space for the Unbound
overview: rural Indonesian town during the late 1990s, A Space for the Unbound follows the deeply emotional journey of Atma and Raya, two high school sweethearts facing the anxieties of graduation and adulthood. When a mysterious, cosmic supernatural power suddenly threatens their reality, Atma must use a unique ability called "Space Dive" to leap into the subconscious minds of others, uncovering hidden traumas, curing inner anxieties, and discovering painful secrets about their own past before the world comes to an end.
